sentences.text:
This appeal coming on for admission this day, th e court  following:
 ORDER Heard on I.A.No.12615/2023, an application for condoning of delay of 1852 days.
2. Learned counsel for the appellant, after referring to impugned award submits that appellant has a good case for enhancement of compensation.
His left leg has been amputated from below the knee.
The appellant was under impression that his appeal has already been filed.

Therefore, he could not Narmada Prasad vs Keshram on 9 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/79608050/
1 file the same.
But later-on, he came to know that no appeal has been filed.
Motor vehicle Act is a beneficial legislation.
Therefore, delay in filing the appeal be condoned.
3. Learned counsel for the respondent-Insurance Company submits that there is a huge delay in filing present appeal and no bonafide reasons have been assigned for the same.
Therefore, delay cannot be condoned.
4. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.
5. Perusal of I.A. reveals that there is a delay of 1852 days in filing present appeal.
I have also gone through the reasons for delay as mentioned in para-2 of I.A. for not filing appeal within time.
It is correct that motor vehicle Act is a beneficial legislation.
But in view of reasons assigned for delay in filing appeal and period of delay, in this Court's opinion, no ground is made out for condoning the huge/inordinate delay.
Therefore, application filed by appellant is dismissed.
Resultantly, appeal filed by appellant is also dismissed as time barred .

6. I.A. and appeal disposed off accordingly.
(ACHAL KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE vai Narmada Prasad vs Keshram on 9 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/79608050/
